name: Level 2 - Daily 12 minutes
note: Recognition on Level 2; production finishing Level 1.

blocks.label: Warm up: re and la in one key
blocks.note: One key, so the two new notes settle against do.

blocks.label: Main block: Level 2
blocks.note: Re falls to do, la falls to sol. Feel which way it leans.

blocks.label: Reverse it: Level 1
blocks.note: A new key every question, and a cadence that doesn't hand you sol.
